name: jailGate
meaning: first FallingGate2 (class 0x8C) in the level; msg 0x72 asks whether it is open (returns CLOSED==0)

name: jailBox
meaning: PROPERTY JAIL_BOX (Lvl-15 id 617)

name: nearJailBox
meaning: PROPERTY BOX_NEAR_JAIL (618)

name: bridgeBox
meaning: PROPERTY BRIDGE_BOX (619): the boat bridge; on-boat test and talk trigger

name: forbiddenBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: PROPERTY BOX_FORBIDDEN id list (669, 2 boxes): a target coin inside one aborts the hunt (state 0xE) | count (+4): count for forbiddenBoxes

name: state
meaning: Sam_PirateState (0..0x11), written by Sam_Pirate_SetState

name: pocketStep
meaning: state 0xD coin-pocketing step (0: lift coin 50 + scale 0x2aa, 1: scale 0x155)

name: idleAnimIdx
meaning: current idle index 0..3 into g_samPirateBoatIdleAnims / JailIdleAnims (never repeats twice)

name: idleAnimPick
meaning: scratch for the Rand_Bounded(4) re-roll

name: coinScale
meaning: render scale sent to the target coin with msg 0x4A82 (0x400, then 0x2aa, then 0x155)

name: wolfDist
meaning: state 4: Vec3s_DistXZ(Wolf, Sam); < 401 draws

name: timerMs
meaning: g_dtMs countdown: idle length (2x or 4x anim), shoot length (2 x anim 1), 700/100 ms coin steps, 1000 ms stare

name: spawnPos
meaning: pos after SnapToGround in Init; Reset and idle 0 teleport here; state 2 walks here

name: jailSpot
meaning: pos on reaching nearJailPos (state 0xF end); jail idle 0 teleports here; state 3 walks back here

name: circleOffset
meaning: pos - circlePivot at idle-0 start (= (±150,0,0)); rotated each frame by CircleStep

name: bridgeEndPos
meaning: farthest TRAJ_BOAT point from spawn (Lvl-15: 2898,-24,6277); route point for leaving/boarding the boat; idle anims face it

name: guardPost
meaning: nearest TRAJ_BOAT point (Lvl-15: 1294,-200,6275); home for states 1/0xE/0x11 and the talk-trigger centre

name: trajExclude
meaning: zeroed in Init and passed as the excluded point to Sam_Pirate_PickTrajPoint; no other use

name: nearJailPos
meaning: centre of BOX_NEAR_JAIL (XZ) at ground height; jail walk target and jail talk-trigger centre

name: jailedOnce
meaning: set on the first entry to state 0x10 (forces idle 3); gates the top-of-frame jail check; never reset

name: coinFound
meaning: state 9 scratch: a reachable free coin was found this frame

name: coinPickedBefore
meaning: set by SetState(0xC); cleared by SetState(4). When set, a reached coin goes straight to state 0xD (skips the pick-up anim)

name: coins
meaning: GoldenCoins (class 0x8D) found by Scenaric_FindByClass, limited to NBER_OF_COIN. Capacity up to +0x12c is inferred from the next field

name: targetCoin
meaning: coin being hunted or pocketed

name: coinSearchOrigin
meaning: reference for the 601-unit coin radius: Sam's pos (set when zero or unless keepSearchOrigin), or the last pocketed coin's pos; cleared in state 4

name: coinCount
meaning: number of coins actually found (written, not read in this class)

name: nbCoins
meaning: PROPERTY NBER_OF_COIN (Lvl-15: 10); loop bound for coins[]

name: nearestCoinDist
meaning: best coin distance in state 9 (reset to 600)

name: coinHuntActive
meaning: set in states 2/9; cleared in state 4 and the non-jail Reset. While 0, the top-of-frame coin scan runs in every state

name: keepSearchOrigin
meaning: set by state 0xD so the next state-9 search is centred on the pocketed coin

name: circlePivot
meaning: spawnPos.x-150 (boat) or jailSpot.x+150 (jail)

name: circleAngle
meaning: accumulated angle (starts -30, -30 per frame). Idle ends when |angle| > 0x2ffd (3 laps, boat) or > 0x1ffe (2 laps, jail)

name: onBoat
meaning: 1 if Sam's XZ is in bridgeBox, or |pos.y| > |guardPost.y| - 10 (on deck); drives routing, coin filters and texts

name: trajFollower
meaning: initialised on TRAJ_BOAT (speed 250, radius 50) but never stepped (dead)

name: trajBoat
meaning: PROPERTY TRAJ_BOAT trajectory {u16 count; Vec3s pts[]}

name: trajPointCount
meaning: copied from trajBoat[0] (Lvl-15: 2)

name: trajPoints
meaning: copy of the TRAJ_BOAT points. Capacity 10 is inferred from the next field (+0x1bc); there is no bound check

name: dustParams
meaning: EmitterDriftParams: hSpeed = Emitter_UpdateDrift params p[0] = 100: horizontal drift units/s; vSpeed = p[1] = -20: vertical drift/s (up); life = p[2] = 0x1000 (1 s); spawnInterval = p[3] = 0x1000/6. The role 'spawn period' is inferred; sizeStart = 10; sizeEnd = 0x28; sheetIndex = sprite sheet index of the dust drift params (the +0x14 byte of the drift-param block, as Robot "sheet" / GroundMine "ringParams.sheetIndex"). 0 (last byte of the drift params)

name: dustEmitter
meaning: running dust (spawns in states 9/0xE), drawn by Sam_Pirate_Render; inline storage 0x1d4..0x338: factory 0x4722d7 sets slotPool = +0x24, particles = +0xe4, count 0x10 (0x472319-0x472335) and calls Emitter_Reset 0x52dbe3 (0x47233c) before the Sam_Pirate vptr (0x472344)

name: shotSoundHandle
meaning: handle of sound 0xF4 started in SetState(7); stopped when the state-8 anim ends

name: textInBoat1
meaning: string of PROPERTY TEXT_IN_BOAT1 (voice 0x38)

name: textInBoat2
meaning: TEXT_IN_BOAT2 (voice 0x39)

name: textInJail
meaning: TEXT_IN_JAIL (voice 0x3A)

name: talkedFlag
meaning: 1 after a dialogue. Blocks re-talk until the Wolf is > 600 from guardPost (boat) or > 400 from nearJailPos (jail). Cleared by Reset

name: boatTextToggle
meaning: alternates TEXT_IN_BOAT1/2 between boat talks

name: jailWarningGiven
meaning: set while TEXT_IN_JAIL is spoken. Afterwards the Wolf entering jailBox makes jailed Sam draw (state 5). NOT cleared by Reset
